items.title: Bob Lovett Interview, 1949-04-01
items.q: Yeah, Peretti was around. I remember seeing him a lot.

ctx.x: Was Peretti in New York at that time?
Yeah, Peretti was around. I remember seeing him a lot.
Because he and Wellstead worked a lot later. Yes. Right. Did Janice have any steady jobs in this period that you were with him?
